Flow: API Flow: STEP 5: Send notifications  ·  Tenant backend
API: Send bulk: same message to many recipients
What happens: One item, many targets. Email / SMS / push tokens: "recipients": [...] or a comma-separated "recipient". Push / in-app users: "userIds": [...]. Each target becomes its own notification (own id, status, retry), in order, duplicates dropped; accepted = number of targets. idempotencyKey gets a per-recipient suffix ("key:<hash>"), so repeating the request replays instead of sending twice. At most 500 notifications after expanding. Several recipients and several userIds in one item is a VALIDATION_ERROR; recipients / userIds on POST /v1/notifications (single send) is a VALIDATION_ERROR.
